WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FORThe BOXER 8x8 is the leading armoured vehicle with a multi-national user background that has been developed in a joint co-operation programme between Germany and the Netherlands by the international consortium ARTEC GmbH in Munich, Germany. ARTEC is a joint-venture of KNDS Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG, Rheinmetall Landsysteme GmbH and Rheinmetall Defence Nederland B.V. It is the prime contractor responsible for the BOXER Programme, the co-ordination of series production and the focal point for export opportunities. Annual sales are normally between 200 and 300 million EUR and as of December 2025 more than 2,000 BOXER vehicles have been contracted. Further large-scale projects are in the pipeline.WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FORIn the role of the Integrated Logistic Support (ILS) Project Engineer BOXER you are responsible for all matters regarding the logistic deliverables of the leading multi-national 8x8 military armoured vehicle programme. At the industry consortium ARTEC, all technical and cross-discipline activities are focused on making a good product even better to protect the future and security of Europe and Worldwide.Parts of the ILS Project Engineer role:- Managing and coordination of the contractual ILS requirements of one or several BOXER projects.- Main emphasis on Logistic Support Analysis (LSA), Technical Documentation (IETP) and Material Management.- Act as interface between ILS and other disciplines such as Engineering and Safety within ARTEC.- Assignment and coordination of ILS tasks to specific Main Subcontractors within the Consortium (Rheinmetall and KNDS).- Coordinating ILS matters and act as the focal point for lLS between industry and Official Services (OCCAR/NSPA).- Host and chair review meetings with our customer Nations.- Coordinate activities throughout ARTEC's internal disciplines.- Be responsible for time, cost and quality for ILS activities in BOXER programme.- Continuous improvement of processes and monitoring of KPIs.- Bachelor degree, engineer, technician or comparable qualification.- Experience in customer support and/or defence area, preferable armoured vehicle manufacturer desired.- Experience in one of the logistics main disciplines (technical publication, materiel management or logistics support analysis).- Knowledge of ASD standards, with focus on S1000D and S2000M.- Working knowledge of MIL-STD-1388 preferred.- Strong organizational and communication skills.- Ability to quickly understand and facilitate complex technical relations.- Business fluent in German and English written and spoken.- Strong scheduling/planning skills.- Willingness to travel.ARTEC is characterized by a flat hierarchy with a project-matrix organisation. This provides the opportunity for you as BOXER ILS Project Engineer to work on multiple international projects with different team members from different countries at the same time.The office is located in Munich - the most liveable city in Germany.- Interesting and varied opportunities in a leading role for large scale and demanding International and National projects across the whole life cycle (development, series production, In-Service Support) of a state-of-the art military vehicle.- Individual training opportunities offered by externals as well as a consortium owned academy.- A state-of-the-art office that is easily accessible by public or private transport within Munich.- Attractive payment package and pension.- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family.- Flexible working hours incl. 40% mobile working possible as a standard.- Wide range of corporate benefits.- Offsite and team building events to underline the modern working environment.- Medical service at the location.- Job Bike.- Subsidized D-Ticket.- Access to EGYM Wellpass.

jobs.description: #WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Ambition makes the difference. Are you ready for the challenge? As part of Infineon's International Graduate Program, you'll rotate through impactful roles, collaborate with global teams, and develop the skills to shape the Infineon of tomorrow. Start your journey to a career where your ambition meets endless possibilities. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new roleAs an Engineer SoC Flow and Methodology IGP, you will contribute to empowering the SoC Implementation community and enhance their effectiveness and efficiency. You will also analyze technical problems and drive issue resolution with various colleagues from other departments, while having the chance to foster technical alignment and agreement on future solutions within the global SoC implementation community.Your program consists of the following elements:·      Work across the key areas of SoC R&D, gaining exposure to advanced RTL2GDS implementations, future flow and methodology development and much more·      Embark on an international assignment of 4-8 months at our sites in Asia and Europe ·      Benefit from tailored training sessions and individual mentoring to accelerate your professional growth·      Take ownership of impactful projects that focus on implementing digital solutions to optimize manufacturing processes and integrate external partners·      Improve and develop concepts and methodologies to increase the quality and efficiency·      Support strategic decision making and the roadmap process for the SoC implementation ecosystemYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed You are curious and interested in a broad range of topics. You don’t expect things to be handed to you on a silver platter – you go search for them. You love change – which is guaranteed in the semiconductor industry. You are pragmatic and analytic, because we need both at Infineon. Standing still is not your thing. You find inspiration in teamwork, collaborating with your colleagues in the big picture. You can confidently lead and drive results in your field, leveraging your skills and expertise to achieve success.- Master’s degree and outstanding performance in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Technical Computer Science or similar technical programs - Already gained first work experience  in combining technical skills with customer topics, e.g. through internships in consulting others technically- Work effectively in a multi-site environment involving teams in India, Germany (Munich and Duisburg)- Interact with colleagues across different locations, time zones, working styles, and cultural backgrounds while being open-minded, respectful, proactive, and willing to understand how different teams operate- Showing reliability, ownership, and maturity in day-to-day collaboration and being comfortable with virtual collaboration tools - Experience spending time abroad, either studying or doing an internship- Strong behavioural awareness, cultural sensitivity, and professional communication- Ideally gained first experience in academic projects and enjoyed taking on responsibility and     leadership tasks- Excellent English communication, German is a plusAnd you fully agree with these statements: - I am* *an ambitious and open-minded person who loves to get to know new people and learn about new topics - When I think about moving to another country for at least three months, I want to start packing my bags- I like to work in teams that are very diverse - I can’t wait to present a concept to team and managers – and I don’t mind doing it in English - My friends describe me as “technology-savvy”If this is you, then we want to make it easy for you to apply: All we need is your CV and your relevant certificates, such as your final university degree or your most recent university transcripts. Also, tell us a bit more about your motivation for applying in a short cover letter. Convince us with your personality, special skills and experiences. #WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.

jobs.occupation: Internship (d/f/m) - Electrical Engineering and Test (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the Electrical Systems department, Airbus Defence and Space is offering anInternship (d/f/m) - Electrical Engineering and TestAre you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Space Electrical Engineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Electrical Systems department as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Immenstaad / Friedrichshafen- Start: 01.03.2027- Duration: 3-6 monthsSatellites are composed of highly sophisticated subsystems, equipment and payloads. There units communicated with each other and towards other satellites and ground stations by high frequency electrical or optical signals. Electromagnetic compatibility and immunity (EMC) of all these subsystems, equipment and payloads are essential for reliable satellite operations and final mission success. EMC is subsequently taken into account early on in the project and up to final acceptance by design rules, analysis, inspections and tests.In the frame of an internship of 3-6 months within an EMC laboratory, existing and partially automated test setups shall be upgraded and extended. Correct function and performance shall be verified by reference tests. Test equipment, computer and software shall be functionally integrated. This includes adaptation of existing test scripts. Tasks will be performed in close collaboration with experienced engineers and will partially be utilized in running projects. The implementation shall be done in LabView, Visual Basic and MatLab.The department in which this internship will be allocated is responsible for the engineering and the verification of electrical systems of satellites for earth observation, navigation and science. The department supports all satellite projects in Friedrichshafen. This support includes the fields of RF communications, electromagnetic cleanliness, electrical power supply, harness design and data processing. It includes a broad band of services in the field of analysis and test.Your locationAt the Airbus site in Immenstaad on Lake Constance, you’ll work where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power takes shape. In an environment that offers vision, you will shape technological innovations across domains.Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you’ll connect with a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as tomorrow's Combat Cloud and Ground Support. Our collaboration is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Update existing test scripts for the EMC Laboratory.- Implement new test equipment into the (semi)automatic test chains.- Validate the modified test scripts in realistic test environments.- Optimize the test data transfer into formal test reports.- Support formal Electromagnetic Compatibility Tests with real flight hardware.Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Electrotechnics (Power or Data Communication Electronics), Microwave Technology, Physics  or an equivalent field of study.- First practical experience in the field of Test Equipment utilisation, Test setups and Test execution is desirable.- Fluent in German and English.- MatLab, LabView or Visual Basics and Python are required.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the physical design process support, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a3DEXPERIENCE & DMU Data Specialist | Physical Design & Engineering IT (d/f/m)Ready to help shape the future of flight? As a DMU (Digital Mock-Up) Data Integrator at Airbus, you will be at the heart of our virtual aircraft development. While hundreds of engineers design structural, cabin, electrical, and hydraulic systems across various ATA chapters, you bring the pieces together. You will build, maintain, and validate our central 3D master model—turning individual CAD subsystems into a seamless, Configured DMU (cDMU). By detecting geometric clashes and ensuring flawless spatial integration early on, you prevent costly production issues before the first part is ever built.MissionTo deliver daily operational support to design engineering teams, maintain high data quality standards, and drive user adoption of 3DEXPERIENCE (3DX) and standardized physical design processes across all sites to achieve Right-First-Time quality and Cost of Non-Quality (CNQ) reductions. In this role, you will support strategic, mission-critical programs and sovereign defense technologies, ensuring the digital integrity of next-generation defense platforms.Your locationAt the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. naming conventions.- BOM & Structure Support: Assist in verifying Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) structures, multi-level Bills of Materials (BOMs), and master data integrity across design lifecycles.- Migration Verification: Validate data integrity during data synchronization and migration activities into the target 3DEXPERIENCE environment.Cross-Pillar Operational Support & Testing Autobrains is seeking a professional and experienced Autonomous Vehicle Test Operator to join our Systems Engineering team in Munich. In this pivotal role, you will lead daily on-road testing operations and collaborate closely with our R&D teams to advance our self-driving technology. More than just driving, you will actively contribute to vehicle builds, system troubleshooting, and fleet operations in a fast-paced, international environment. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and shaping the future of mobility, this high-impact role is for you.Autobrains is an Israei Start Up, leading AI company in the automated driving space, backed by leading strategic and financial investors.
